text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I have a great idea!!! This year, let's 
rent out an island while the cherry 
blossoms are in full bloom, and make the 
most of it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
―― I was told to get on a boat, but it 
looks like there's been a bit of an 
accident.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sei-chan loves this～. It's an island full 
of cats instead of cherry blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Kitty cat, kitty cat, lets take a little 
nap together me～ow ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, what a warm welcome～. I might stay 
here for a while meow～.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm… This picture turned out pretty nice, 
a cat on a deserted island.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? They keep getting too close, I can't 
get a good picture, so I'm going to go…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess panicking wont get us 
anywhere. I think I'll take a little nap 
too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Luckily, I don't think Sky or Taishin-san 
are around either.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah…! I know this isn't the time or 
place for this… but I feel like I'm being 
healed～.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fluffy… fluffy… This must be what heaven 
feels like…

A few hours later, the three were found by 
a search and rescue team. They were all 
sleeping happily with the cats.
